_comment: The one file you tune per project (/harness-init writes the stack bits; harness.schema.json is the field reference). A project = one-or-more components, each with its own gate, plus a cross-cutting root gate.

models._comment: Per-phase {model, fallback, effort, fallbackEffort}: a Claude alias/ID or the literal 'codex'; null = inherit session / no fallback. Fallback fires only on a FAILED invocation (unavailable or usage-limited). Enforced via settings.json `model`, agent frontmatter, and the loop dispatcher — /harness-doctor check 10 validates agreement. `effort` is DECLARED here and ENFORCED by settings.json `effortLevel` (session) + the phase agent's `effort:` frontmatter (subagents) — doctor check 10e validates both. Advisory by design: implement.effort (the codex arm reads models.codex.reasoningEffort) and review/evaluate fallbackEffort (a usage-cap re-spawn pins the model, not the depth). The headless dispatcher passes --model only.

parallel._comment: Fleet runner: opt-in parallel workers over independent tasks (declared 'files' ownership), serialized merge queue. Review bandwidth binds before compute.

gate._comment: Cross-cutting gate, run from the repo ROOT after every component gate passes (usually just the e2e; all-null for a single-component project).

promotion._comment: Risk-gated promotion (/promote). Deterministic rules classify the diff first and can only RAISE the tier; a fresh-context risk-classifier agent then runs and can only raise it further. LOW may auto-approve + auto-merge to staging; MEDIUM/HIGH go to a human; anything matching alwaysHuman or moneySignals is HIGH unconditionally; prod is NEVER automated. Off by default — turn on deliberately, per docs/promotion.md.
